items.title: Curtis Fuller — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: It’s only me that I knew of him.

ctx.x: Did he pass of natural causes?

As far as I know, he passed of Tuberculosis. The person, when they’re killed…he came to work at the Ford factory. It was a whole thing, that’s what made the story believable to me. I would go to Mr. Brigg’s house in the building to see a picture of my father, praying everyday. It’s only me that I knew of him. But, my mother was there and by that time, you know, but even before she passed I had already formed this thing about self-containment. I kept to myself, always. I’ve always done that. It’s been a detriment…
So, you grew up in an orphanage?
